title: Performed at the Lok Bhavan Banquet, Chennai
description: Performed before the Hon'ble Vice-President of India, Thiru C. P. Radhakrishnan, at a banquet held in his honour at Lok Bhavan, Tamil Nadu.

title: Performed at Raj Bhavan, Chennai
description: Performed in the presence of the Vice-President of India, the Governor of Tamil Nadu, the Speaker of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly, and other distinguished dignitaries.

title: Winner — The Hindu Margazhi Music Competition (Veena)
description: Recognised among the winners of The Hindu Margazhi competition, earning the opportunity to perform before the Vice-President of India and the Governor of Tamil Nadu.

title: Recognised — Shakthi Sangeetha Sabha competitions
description: Received recognition in music competitions conducted by Shakthi Sangeetha Sabha.
